# dev AWS ECS

This root environment composes ClusterForge modules for:

- AWS tags
- AWS VPC networking
- AWS ECS/Fargate cluster

Provider configuration lives in this root. No credentials or secrets are
generated into Terraform variable files.

## Usage

```sh
terraform init
terraform plan
terraform apply
```

For reviewed changes, prefer:

```sh
terraform plan -out .cf/plans/dev.tfplan
terraform apply .cf/plans/dev.tfplan
```

Do not apply production changes without review.
